title: NICAP's founding as a possible link to the 1956 cutoff

tellings.quote: that's when NICAP formed, which was the first civilian UFO research program.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks with an astronomer, Beatriz Villarroel, about a change around 1956 that they are discussing. Michels points out that this is when NICAP, which he calls the first civilian UFO research group in the United States, was formed. He suggests the timing could be connected, which would mean public UFO research and the change happened together for a reason.
